ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the recent findings of vulnerabilities in 14 Medicaid programs and potential fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid system
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover potential Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
questions: What are the specific vulnerabilities found in the Medicaid programs?
How much money is potentially at risk?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a significant issue with Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, potentially leading to policy changes and accountability

ideas.title: The Renee Good Shooting: A Review of the Investigation
ideas.description: Review the stalled FBI investigation into the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an immigration agent
ideas.angle: Examine the concerns and potential wrongdoing in the shooting
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
What concerns have been raised about the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on potential wrongdoing and lack of accountability in the shooting
